newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks drop at noon on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks drop at noon on selling pressure.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dropped at noon on Monday on selling pressure in index-weighted stocks and dealers said prices would slip further on lack of interest from genuine investors.
"There is heavy selling pressure in blue-chip stocks like PTCL and Hub Power after their GDRs (Global Depositary Receipt) fell abroad," dealer Shakil Anwar said.
The Karachi 100-share index fell 8.71 points, or 0.57 percent, to 1,528.80 at noon. Losers beat gainers 154 to 46. PTCL fell 0.95 rupees to 25.50 and Hub Power 0.60 to 37.10.
